item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, October 9, 2026 – On the eve of World Migratory Bird Day, Shanghai Disney Resort unveiled three Siberian crane sculptures at Wishing Star Park. Showcasing these critically endangered cranes in various stages of flight, the sculptures celebrate their beauty and resilience. By connecting Wishing Star Park with Poyang Lake, an important habitat for Siberian cranes, through the story of crane conservation, the sculptures reflect the resort’s commitment to nature, adding a new point of discovery to the park and inviting guests, particularly those staying at the two lakeside hotels by Wishing Star Lake.

 

 

This morning, the “Magic Along the Flyway” Siberian Crane Sculpture Unveiling Ceremony was held at Wishing Star Park. Representatives from government, the International Crane Foundation (ICF) and nonprofit organizations, together with the crane sculptures’ artist, local school students and teachers, and Shanghai Disney Resort Cast Members, gathered at Wishing Star Park to witness the unveiling of the three sculptures.

The alliance, recognizing Whisper as an Official Participant of Shanghai Disney Resort, reflects both organizations’ shared commitment to quality, convenience […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, September 21, 2026 – Shanghai Disney Resort and Whisper today jointly announced a multi-year alliance, bringing added convenience and care to guests through the introduction of Whisper Menstrual Pad Vending Machine across the resort. The alliance, recognizing Whisper as an Official Participant of Shanghai Disney Resort, reflects both organizations’ shared commitment to quality, convenience and creating positive experiences.

The alliance reflects Shanghai Disney Resort’s ongoing efforts to listen to guests and seek opportunities to respond to their needs. In collaborating with Whisper, the resort has chosen to work with a reputable feminine care brand that will further enhance the guest experience through thoughtful services and support. It also marks an important step in Whisper’s ongoing efforts to support women’s confidence and menstrual well-being by creating more period-friendly experiences.

As part of the alliance, Whisper Menstrual Pad Vending Machines will be installed phase by phase in most of the women’s restrooms across Shanghai Disney Resort, covering the various themed lands within its theme park as well as Disneytown. By integrating period care support into everyday guest touchpoints, the alliance delivers convenience to guests with menstrual health needs, helping them navigate unexpected moments and enjoy their visit in comfort and with confidence, from morning until night.

In the coming months, Whisper Menstrual Pad Vending Machines will be gradually rolled out in women’s restrooms across the resort. Shanghai Disney Resort and Whisper will also explore opportunities to engage guests through innovative experiences and consumer outreach activations. The alliance also reflects a shared commitment to quality, innovation and community support through meaningful initiatives. Kicking things off, Duffy and Friends will invite everyone to set sail on brand-new adventures from September 1 to […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, August 20, 2026 – As the weather cools and autumn hues begin to settle in, an enchanting season unfolds at Shanghai Disney Resort, offering a golden harvest of immersive experiences throughout autumn’s celebrations and holidays. Kicking things off, Duffy and Friends will invite everyone to set sail on brand-new adventures from September 1 to 30, 2026, joined by a week-long celebration for LinaBell’s fifth anniversary from September 23 to 29. Following closely, Halloween will return from October 4 to November 1, 2026, bringing an extended ten Spook-tacular Days and even more “With You, It’s Magic+” moments. Coinciding with these celebrations, the Mid-Autumn Festival and Golden Week national holiday will offer even more opportunities for family and friends to create special memories while exploring the seasonal beauty at Shanghai Disney Resort this autumn.

 

 

Set sail this Duffy Month on an all-new voyage where stories and friendship come together

Drawing inspiration from the heartwarming stories of Duffy and Friends, the resort’s 10th Birthday Special Duffy Month will invite guests and fans to “board” the FriendSHIP and set sail together for a whole month of new adventures.

item.dc:creator: wangz427

Recognized as Disney’s flagship global fan event, D23 serves as a platform for showcasing major announcements and new […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, August 16, 2026 – Shanghai Disney Resort today shared new updates on the Spider-Man-themed land coming to Shanghai Disneyland, in parallel with announcements made at the highly anticipated biennial D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event (“D23”). Recognized as Disney’s flagship global fan event, D23 serves as a platform for showcasing major announcements and new developments from across The Walt Disney Company. Bringing together fans, creators, and industry observers from around the world, the event offers a first look at future Disney stories and experiences, making it a fitting stage to share the latest progress on Shanghai Disneyland’s newest themed land.

As Shanghai Disneyland’s ninth themed land and the third major expansion since the park’s opening, the Spider-Man-themed land was first announced at D23 in 2024. Development has continued to move forward steadily over the past two years. Following the completion of ride track installation in June, the first ride vehicles will be placed on the track imminently, officially launching ride vehicle testing and marking a significant milestone to create this exciting new land.

item.dc:creator: sud005

item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, June 16, 2026 – A decade after its gates opened, Shanghai Disney Resort has grown into a beloved community and tourist destination – a place where countless guests of all ages from across Shanghai and around the world have embarked on unforgettable experiences filled with tremendous joy and wonder. Today, as the resort officially turned ten, tens of thousands of guests joined cast members in front of Shanghai Disneyland’s iconic Enchanted Storybook Castle for a special birthday celebration moment. Together their voices rose as one in the heartfelt chorus of “Happy Birthday,” celebrating a decade of happiness, wonder, inspiration and magic.

 

From left to right: Guan Yetong, President of Shendi Group; Guan Taoping, Chair of Shendi Group; Shen Shanzhou, Executive Deputy Director General of the Administrative Commission of Shanghai International Resort; Thomas Mazloum, Chairman of Disney Experiences; Tasia Filippatos, President and Managing Director of Disney Parks International and Andrew Bolstein, President and General Manager of Shanghai Disney Resort joined the stage for Shanghai Disney Resort’s 10th Birthday Celebration

item.title: Shanghai Disney Resort Celebrates 10 Years of Magic
item.dc:creator: sud005
item.description: Shanghai, June 16, 2026 – Ten years ago, on June 16, 2016, Shanghai Disney Resort opened its gates of imagination, inspiration and magic to guests from across China and around the world. The resort has since marked more than 100 million guest visits, sharing Disney storytelling and exclusive experiences with them, establishing itself as a […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, June 16, 2026 – Ten years ago, on June 16, 2016, Shanghai Disney Resort opened its gates of imagination, inspiration and magic to guests from across China and around the world. The resort has since marked more than 100 million guest visits, sharing Disney storytelling and exclusive experiences with them, establishing itself as a landmark tourism destination that is “Authentically Disney and Distinctly Chinese.” On the eve of the official anniversary milestone date, resort shareholders and leadership gathered together with a wide range of local stakeholders, including partners, guests and Disney cast members who have helped shape the resort’s remarkable 10-year journey, to celebrate a decade of inspiration and happiness. The occasion was celebrated in grand style, with honored guests welcomed on the red carpet, a festive anniversary gala at the Enchanted Storybook Castle, followed by a spectacular nighttime show that paid tribute to the resort’s remarkable history and looked ahead to many more years of magic to come.

 

The evening reached its grand finale as Bob Iger, former Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of The Walt Disney Company, and Josh D’Amaro, Chief Executive Officer of The Walt Disney Company, joined by musical artist guests, as well as Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse, gathered before the Enchanted Storybook Castle. item.dc:creator: sud005

Toys Homecoming Student Month kicks off the festivities in June, as Disney and […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, June 8, 2026 – Shanghai Disney Resort is turning up the excitement this summer as the resort’s year-long 10th Birthday Celebration continues to sparkle with a spectacular lineup of entertainment, seasonal festivities and unforgettable experiences from June 17 to August 31. Toys Homecoming Student Month kicks off the festivities in June, as Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5 arrives in Chinese cinemas on June 19 alongside its North America debut. On top of exclusive seasonal treats and fresh magical programs for the 10th Birthday Celebration, guests will also be the first to experience brand-new Magic Hour Upgrade Days with extended hours on select nights. With wave after wave of fun on the horizon, everyone is invited to join the celebrations at Shanghai Disney Resort this summer.

 

 

Toy Story 5-themed Student Month kicks off summer playtime

All June, Shanghai Disney Resort celebrates the highly anticipated Toy Story 5 movie premiere with a special Toy Story edition of Student Month packed with hidden surprises from the movie. This magic can be found throughout Disney·Pixar Toy Story Land and Toy Story Hotel, where themed décor brings new Toy Story 5 scenes into the resort. item.title: Shanghai Disney Resort Celebrates a Decade of Citizenship and Community Engagement on International Children’s Day
item.dc:creator: sud005
item.description: Shanghai, June 1, 2026 – Shanghai Disney Resort is committed to being a responsible corporate citizen and active member of the community, inspiring children, families, youth and senior citizens, supporting environmental sustainability, promoting local culture and advocating for accessibility and inclusion for all. The resort also makes a positive difference in children’s lives by fostering […]
item.content:encoded:
Shanghai, June 1, 2026 – Shanghai Disney Resort is committed to being a responsible corporate citizen and active member of the community, inspiring children, families, youth and senior citizens, supporting environmental sustainability, promoting local culture and advocating for accessibility and inclusion for all.  The resort also makes a positive difference in children’s lives by fostering hope, creativity, and opportunity through storytelling, experiences, and social impact initiatives. In honor of International Children’s Day, today, Shanghai Disney Resort released its 10th Anniversary Community Report, highlighting the many ways in which the resort has sought to deliver on its citizenship and community engagement priorities and create a positive impact on the broader community and shared environment.

 

 

The community celebration and report release came just a few days after the resort granted its 500th Disney wish to a young child living with a critical illness.  On May 27, 11-year-old Xixi met her favorite Disney Princess, Cinderella, and spent a magical day with her family at Shanghai Disneyland. item.title: Creating an Urban Wetland Ecosystem: A Case Study of Shanghai Disney Resort Wishing Star Park
item.dc:creator: sud005
item.description: Shanghai Disney Resort’s design and construction rest on a foundation of sustainability and conservation. A prime example is Wishing Star Park, a 500,000-square-meter urban wetland located inside Shanghai Disney Resort. In April 2026, Shanghai Disney Resort and Disney Conservation jointly released Creating an Urban Wetland Ecosystem: A Case Study of Shanghai Disney Resort Wishing Star Park. Building on a decade of monthly bird surveys and learnings from the urban biodiversity development at Wishing Star Park, the Report provides a case study of how an urban wetland project can be designed and managed to enrich the lives of both wildlife and people.
